meta.name: brand-landingpage
meta.description: Brand-first landing page designer — runs a brand-identity interview (colors, typography, shape language), then generates and iterates on a polished landing page via Stitch with deployment-ready HTML. Use when the user asks to create, design, or build a landing page, homepage, or marketing page and has no established visual direction. Skip when they have a design mockup, need a dashboard or app UI, are working at component level, building a multi-page app, or restyling with known design tokens — use frontend-design instead.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 进行品牌访谈,生成可直接部署的落地页
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果需要一个有品牌调性的落地页但还没定视觉方向
copy.tagline_en: Run a brand interview and generate a deployable landing page.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need a brand-oriented landing page but don't have a visual direction.

howto.what: 让 Claude 担任品牌优先的落地页设计师:先访谈收集产品与视觉偏好,再生成页面并打开预览,按反馈反复修改,最后交付可部署的 HTML 与说明。
howto.when: 当你想新建“落地页/首页/营销页”且尚未确定视觉风格时触发;已有设计稿、需要后台界面或多页应用等场景不适用。

say.text: 为我的新产品设计一个落地页,品牌风格还没定,按你的流程来。
say.note: 会先进行简短品牌访谈,然后按偏好生成页面。

say.text: 我想做一个产品营销页,明亮配色,现代感字体,生成初稿给我看。
say.note: Claude 会记录这些偏好,先确认细节再生成可点评的初稿。

say.text: 我的开发者工具需要一个暗色风格官网,含特性区和注册入口。
say.note: 会先问产品目标用户和希望访客做的动作,再生成首版。

howto.what_en: A brand-first landing-page designer. Claude interviews you about product, audience and visuals, uses Stitch to generate a desktop page, opens it for preview, refines it from your feedback, and delivers deployable HTML with design notes.
howto.when_en: Use it when you ask to create a landing page, homepage, or marketing page without an established visual direction. Not for existing mockups, dashboards/app UIs, or multi-page sites.

say_en.text: Design a landing page for my new product; brand style is open. Follow your process.
say_en.note: It runs a short brand interview first, then generates a page.

say_en.text: I want a product marketing page with bright colors and modern fonts. Show me a first draft.
say_en.note: It records these preferences and confirms details before drafting.

say_en.text: Build a dark-themed homepage for my developer tool, with features and sign-up.
say_en.note: It asks about target users and desired action, then makes version one.
